queries_run: The Chefs' Warehouse distribution channel shift OR business model 2026
Chefs' Warehouse CHEF go-to-market change e-commerce platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 describes the core model as chef-focused specialty foodservice distribution via 44 distribution centers; the only direct-to-consumer channel is Allen Brothers mail/e-commerce for center-of-the-plate products, and no subscription/platform shift is described.
findings.excerpt: Additionally, we market certain of our center-of-the-plate products directly to consumers through our Allen Brothers, Inc. (“Allen Brothers”) mail and e-commerce platform.

channel_business_model_shift.note: Third-party summaries mention digital platform enhancements and route consolidation (Q2 2026 call) but no structural channel shift found in primary sources; e-commerce share figure from a low-authority blog not used.

clues.claim: Q2 2026 earnings summary cites facility and route consolidation and digital platform enhancements.
